general.title: OMIX Limma Analysis
general.instructions:
Fit limma models to a continuous feature-by-sample matrix and aligned sample metadata. Select files explicitly, or attach one upstream result bundle and leave the file selectors blank for unambiguous discovery.

For OMIX Seurat Pseudobulk, keep the continuous matrix, Pseudobulk_Sample_Metadata.csv, and Pseudobulk_Manifest.dcf together. The manifest selects eBayes for Harmony means or eBayes with trend for SCTransform means when Variance Model is auto. Raw-count pseudobulk is rejected and must be analyzed with OMIX DEG Analysis.

categories.name: Inputs
categories.description: Provide one continuous matrix, matching sample metadata, and an optional OMIX Pseudobulk manifest.

categories.name: Model
categories.description: Define groups, contrasts, optional covariates, and repeated-measure blocking.

categories.name: Data Interpretation
categories.description: Declare input scale, variance model, and duplicate-feature summarization.

categories.name: Advanced
categories.description: Restrict samples or control whether modeled values are appended to the result table.

parameters.name: Continuous Matrix File
parameters.description: Feature-by-sample CSV, TSV, TXT, or RDS. Leave blank to discover exactly one compatible continuous matrix under /data.

parameters.name: Sample Metadata File
parameters.description: Aligned sample metadata CSV, TSV, TXT, or RDS. Leave blank to discover exactly one compatible metadata table under /data.

parameters.name: Pseudobulk Manifest
parameters.description: Optional Pseudobulk_Manifest.dcf. Leave blank to use one unambiguous attached manifest or to run a general continuous matrix without one.

parameters.name: Feature ID Column
parameters.description: Feature identifier column in the matrix.

parameters.name: Sample ID Column
parameters.description: Unique sample identifier column in sample metadata.

parameters.name: Contrast Variable Columns
parameters.description: One or two comma-separated metadata columns defining modeled groups.

parameters.name: Contrasts
parameters.description: Required comma-separated limma contrast expressions, such as B-A.

parameters.name: Donor Variable Column
parameters.description: Optional repeated-measure donor or patient column. Use only when a donor contributes multiple modeled profiles.

parameters.name: Input Kind
parameters.description: Declared matrix scale. Raw counts and untransformed proportions are not accepted.

parameters.name: Variance Model
parameters.description: auto uses a compatible Pseudobulk manifest recommendation, otherwise template-equivalent eBayes. Select ebayes_trend only for a justified mean-dependent variance trend.

parameters.name: Duplicate Feature Summarization
parameters.description: How duplicate feature IDs are combined before modeling.

parameters.name: Samples to Include
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated sample IDs. Leave blank to use all metadata samples found in the matrix, in metadata order.

parameters.name: Append Modeled Matrix
parameters.description: Append the aligned modeled sample values to Limma_Analysis.csv.
